title: A58 Evidence Excerpts row
description: Schema for one row of analysis/canonical/core_controls/A58_evidence_excerpts.csv. An excerpt is a verbatim or near-verbatim text snippet drawn from a registered source (A50.SourceID), used as evidence-binding payload for A59 claims. Producer: bsa-evidence-intake. Consumer: bsa-claim-binder + bsa-citation-auditor.

ExcerptID.description: Stable identifier E-NNN, or E-XXX-NNN with category prefix matching the upstream source (e.g., E-INJ-001 for excerpts from S-INJ-001).

SourceID.description: Foreign key into A50_source_register.csv. Every excerpt MUST trace back to a registered source — no orphan excerpts. Same prefix conventions as A50.SourceID.

Locator.description: Position within the source: page number, paragraph index, line range, timestamp (HH:MM:SS for transcripts), CSS selector for HTML, JSONPath for JSON, etc. Free-form but never empty — locator-less excerpts cannot be re-verified.

ExcerptText.description: The verbatim or near-verbatim text content of the excerpt. Required non-empty. Length not capped here — large excerpts are valid (a contract clause or process diagram caption may run several hundred chars).

Notes.description: Free-form annotation: extraction method, redaction notes, alternative-phrasing markers. Empty string allowed.

x-bsa-csv-columns-order._comment: Canonical column order for diff stability.
